sources.title: Inhibition of phospholipase D1 ameliorates hepatocyte steatosis and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
sources.verified_claim: Hepatocyte Pld1 KO lowers PA/LPA under HFD; hepatic-cell PLD1 inhibition lowers PA/LPA; supports class direction, not our exact chain assignments.

sources.title: Inhibited Insulin Signaling in Mouse Hepatocytes Is Associated with Increased Phosphatidic Acid but Not Diacylglycerol
sources.verified_claim: PLD1 or PLD2 overexpression raises total PA without total DAG change in primary mouse hepatocytes; not direct evidence for compensation after KO.

sources.title: Phospholipase D1b and D2a generate structurally identical phosphatidic acid species in mammalian cells
sources.verified_claim: PLD1b/PLD2a produce similar PA profiles in mammalian cell lines, enriched in mono/diunsaturated chains.

sources.title: Phospholipase D1 deficiency in mice causes nonalcoholic fatty liver disease via an autophagy defect
sources.verified_claim: Whole-body Pld1 KO impairs autophagy, decreases lysosomal PA but not total PA, and increases hepatic TG; emphasizes compartment/context.

sources.title: Lysophosphatidic acid counteracts glucagon-induced hepatocyte glucose production via STAT3
sources.verified_claim: PLPP1 KO raises hepatocyte LPA; specific PA-to-DG species predictions are not tested.

sources.title: Lipid phosphate phosphatases form homo- and hetero-oligomers: catalytic competency, subcellular distribution and function
sources.verified_claim: LPP catalytic site extracellular at plasma membrane or luminal at intracellular membranes; unknown compartment bulk PA routes conditional.

sources.title: Mammalian secreted and cytosolic phospholipase A2 show different specificities for phospholipid molecular species
sources.verified_claim: Cytosolic PLA2 highly selective for sn2 20:4n6 phospholipid molecular species; retained arachidonoyl-LPC predictions require unusual position/species assumptions.

sources.title: Structural basis for substrate discrimination and integrin binding by autotaxin
sources.verified_claim: Secreted autotaxin is LPC-to-LPA lysoPLD; no verified support for our diacyl-PC-to-PA catalyst assignment.

sources.title: Action of phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase Cgamma1 on soluble and micellar substrates. Separating effects on catalysis from modulation of the surface
sources.verified_claim: Purified PLCgamma1 hydrolyzes unphosphorylated PI in detergent micelles; physiological specific-chain hepatocyte flux not established.

sources.title: Membrane Binding of Phospholipases C-beta1 and C-beta2 Is Independent of Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-Bisphosphate and the alpha and betagamma Subunits of G Proteins
sources.verified_claim: Identifies PIP2 as major physiological PLCbeta substrate; bulk PI measurement not identical to signaling phosphoinositide pool.

sources.title: Hepatocyte-specific deletion of Pparalpha promotes NAFLD in the context of obesity
sources.verified_claim: Hepatocyte Ppara KO affects hepatic lipidome and steatosis; not validation of selected Plpp1/DG direction.

sources.title: KLF10 integrates circadian timing and sugar signaling to coordinate hepatic metabolism
sources.verified_claim: Hepatocyte-specific Klf10 deletion alters circadian and sugar-related hepatic metabolism.

sources.title: Liver-specific RORalpha deletion does not affect the metabolic susceptibility to western style diet feeding
sources.verified_claim: Conditional Rora deletion found no chow/WSD glucose/lipid phenotype in either sex; limits expected generic perturbation phenotype.

sources.title: GATA6 modulates the ductular reaction to bile duct ligation
sources.verified_claim: Gata6 hepatocyte deletion little structural/function impact; bile-duct context differs.

sources.title: Function of GATA Factors in the Adult Mouse Liver
sources.verified_claim: Combined adult Gata4/Gata6 excision had modest phenotype; compensation test not guaranteed to amplify effects.

sources.title: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor Plays Protective Roles against High Fat Diet-induced Hepatic Steatosis and the Subsequent Lipotoxicity via Direct Transcriptional Regulation of Socs3 Gene Expression
sources.verified_claim: Liver Ahr deletion increased DG/TG under HFD; context opposes naive local Ahr-to-DG knockdown decrease.

sources.title: Induction of the hepatic aryl hydrocarbon receptor by alcohol dysregulates autophagy and phospholipid metabolism via PPP2R2D
sources.verified_claim: Hepatic Ahr deletion improves alcoholic fatty liver; context-dependent net effects.

sources.title: Hepatocyte-Specific Mutation Establishes Retinoid X Receptor alpha as a Heterodimeric Integrator of Multiple Physiological Processes in the Liver
sources.verified_claim: Hepatocyte Rxra mutation compromises broad nuclear receptor pathways; less route-specific perturbation.

sources.title: Selective ablation of retinoid X receptor alpha in hepatocytes impairs their lifespan and regenerative capacity
sources.verified_claim: Hepatocyte Rxra loss can affect survival/regeneration; general-state confounding.

sources.title: NR2F1 and IRE1beta suppress MTP expression and lipoprotein assembly in undifferentiated intestinal epithelial cells
sources.verified_claim: Intestinal-cell study states Nr2f1 not expressed in hepatocytes in that setting; local expression needs gating, not universal absence inference.

sources.title: Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor gamma Regulates the Expression of Lipid Phosphate Phosphohydrolase 1 in Human Vascular Endothelial Cells
sources.verified_claim: PPARG stimulates PLPP1 in HUVECs; PPARA overexpression and agonist explicitly had no effect. Selected Ppara→Plpp1 sole-source paralog mismatch.

sources.title: Mechanism of increased PLD1 gene expression during early adipocyte differentiation process of mouse cell line 3T3-L1
sources.verified_claim: C/EBPbeta but not C/EBPalpha increases PLD1 and binds promoter in 3T3L1 differentiation. Selected Cebpa→Pld1 contradicted in source.

sources.title: The orphan nuclear receptor RORalpha restrains adipocyte differentiation through a reduction of C/EBPbeta activity and perilipin gene expression
sources.verified_claim: RORalpha suppresses CEBPB activity, indirectly inhibiting CEBPA induction in adipocytes. Not direct hepatocyte Rora→Cebpa transcription validation.

sources.title: Oncogenic Ras upregulates NADPH oxidase 1 gene expression through MEK-ERK-dependent phosphorylation of GATA-6
sources.verified_claim: ERK phosphorylates GATA6 and GATA6 activates NOX1 in CaCo2; no GATA6→MAPK1 transcription. Selected edge sole source mismatches direction/mechanism.

sources.title: cPLA2 is phosphorylated and activated by MAP kinase
sources.verified_claim: MAP kinase phosphorylation at cPLA2 S505 increases enzyme activity; supports kinase→enzyme route independent of failed Gata6 edge; generic signaling evidence, not selected hepatic chains.

sources.title: Mechanism of vitamin D3-induced transcription of phospholipase D1 in HaCat human keratinocytes
sources.verified_claim: VitaminD/VDR/RXRA complex activates PLD1 promoter in HaCaT; correct RXRA identity but partner/ligand/cell conditional.

sources.title: Retraction of RXRA-regulated PLD1 cervical cancer study
sources.verified_claim: PMID32067228 retracted in2025; excluded as support for RXRA→PLD1. Other unretracted contextual reference17433303 retained.

critical_issues: Enpp2 diacyl-PC→PA assignment unsupported by verified specific primary chemistry
Pla2g4a PUFA-retaining LPC recipes low-confidence specificity
Plpp1 unknown-compartment PA→DG conditional on substrate accessibility
Plcb1/Plcg1 unphosphorylated PI hydrolysis chemically possible but physiological PIP2 pool not measured
Ppara→Plpp1 paralog mismatch: PPARG studied; PPARA negative in sole cited paper
Cebpa→Pld1 paralog mismatch: CEBPB positive, CEBPA explicitly negative
Gata6→Mapk1 direction/mechanism mismatch: ERK→GATA6 phosphorylation in sole paper
Rora→Cebpa indirect adipocyte context, compounded by invalid Cebpa→Pld1
Rxra→Pld1 vitaminD/VDR heterodimer evidence in HaCaT; hepatocyte single gene direction conditional
